name: Devflow board acceptance on the local Harness Web GUI

steps.prompt: Open the right sidebar using the top-right sidebar icon. Open Devflow in the sidebar start page. Make the Devflow panel fullscreen and switch it to List view so task cards are visible.
The Devflow task board is visible: it shows the task list or board with at least one card entry, not a login error page.
Open the right sidebar using the top-right sidebar icon. Open Devflow in the sidebar start page. Make the Devflow panel fullscreen and switch it to List view so task cards are visible.
Open the task card titled Devflow 页面 Midscene 真实验收（看板与卡片详情）.
The detail view of the card titled Devflow 页面 Midscene 真实验收（看板与卡片详情） is visible and shows its acceptance criteria content.
